answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 41035 Country: India Title: Eating of raw onions Question: Is it unlawful to enter masjid after eating onions? Answer ID: 41035 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1369/1372/M=1433) The mouth has bad smell after eating raw onions hence one should not use raw onion before entering in the mosque or one should clean the mouth with miswak etc thoroughly and remove the bad smell and then enter the mosque so that the angels do not feel hurt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
